EnvironmentJson.description:
A reusable toolchain and runtime environment.

Inputs: toolchain selections, runtime overrides, and reusable policy references.
Outputs: one named context for checking, building, and running the package.

profile.description: Default profile selection for this environment.

mode.description: Default mode selection for this environment.

runtime.description: Runtime environment (browser, node, wasm-wasi, native-managed, etc.).

comptimeEnv.description: Comptime environment whitelist (if omitted, all env keys are visible).

globals.description: Global provider modules for this profile.

derive.description: Derive providers automatically considered in this profile.

sourceMapMode.description: Source map emission mode for this build mode.

sourceMapExcludeSources.description: Whether to omit source contents from emitted source maps.

sourceMapDebugIds.description: Whether to include debug ids in emitted source maps.

legalComments.description: Legal comment handling policy for bundled output.

treeshake.description: Bundled output tree shaking policy for this build mode.

minify.description: Bundled output minification policy for this build mode.

optimize.description: Whether this mode enables optimized code generation.

debugInfo.description: Debug info emission policy for this mode.

strip.description: Symbol stripping policy for this mode.
